title: Queue-Aware Token Communications: Bridging AI Representation and Wireless Service
abstract: arXiv:2610.16730v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid advancement of foundation models and edge intelligence is transforming wireless networks from data-oriented communication systems into artificial intelligence (AI)-native service platforms. Token communications (TokenCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm that directly transmits task-oriented AI representations. However, existing studies typically assume that generated tokens can be transmitted immediately, overlooking the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability. To address this limitation, we introduce Queue-Aware TokenCom, which explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline. We present an end-to-end architecture integrating AI representation generation, token workload management, wireless transmission, and downstream task inference. translated_title: 队列感知的令牌通信：连接AI表示与无线服务
translated_abstract: 基础模型和边缘智能的快速发展，正在将无线网络从面向数据的通信系统转变为人工智能（AI）原生服务平台。令牌通信已成为一种有前景的新范式，可直接传输面向任务的AI表示。然而，现有研究通常假设生成的令牌可以立即传输，忽略了令牌工作负载生成与时变无线服务能力之间的不匹配所产生的排队动态问题。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了队列感知令牌通信，将令牌队列显式地纳入AI服务流程中。我们提出了一种端到端架构，集成了AI表示生成、令牌工作负载管理、无线传输和下游任务推理。随后我们讨论了两个关键设计方向：预算感知的令牌表示优化……
tldr: 提出队列感知令牌通信范式，将令牌队列显式纳入AI服务流程，通过端到端架构解决令牌生成与时变无线服务能力不匹配导致的排队动态问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Queue-Aware TokenCom, a paradigm that explicitly incorporates token queues into the AI service pipeline with an end-to-end architecture, addressing the queueing dynamics arising from the mismatch between token workload generation and time-varying wireless service capability.
